exposure_classification_policy.mixed_month_rule: Any known development/outcome exposure excludes that entire month; otherwise unresolved exposure fails closed
exposure_classification_policy.contamination_rule: Requires evidence of candidate-aligned outcomes made available to a holder of scientific change rights; active collection or public prices alone is insufficient
exposure_classification_policy.source_coverage_rule: An archive/dataset manifest, planned split, sealed declaration or result filename alone is not proof of use, disclosure or cleanliness
exposure_classification_policy.exposure_subaudit_correction: H35/H36/H39 active campaigns alone do not prove September contamination; final September classification is UNKNOWN_FAIL_CLOSED

safe_metadata.artifact_type: protocol freeze manifest; only presence/schema checked
safe_metadata.exposure_note: H39 protocol/development lineage exists; contents beyond non-outcome metadata not read

safe_metadata.note: Attestation contents were not inspected beyond schema-level metadata; cannot assert historical cleanliness.
manifest preregistration exists; no protected results accessed

inventory_limit: Filename/blob inventory is not a proof of candidate alignment, complete runtime history, or contamination; no listed result content was opened for this inventory

potential_source_windows_not_clean_holdo.reserve_note: May 2023 provides lookback reserve, August 2026 endpoint reserve; a complete intervening month exceeds 150h. These are conservative capacity witnesses, not selected partitions.

purge_embargo.formula: 25h raw completed-bar support + 5h endpoint reach + 120h design block buffer = 150h
purge_embargo.authority_status: PROPOSED_FOR_R1_2_ACCEPTANCE; not an already frozen R1_1 embargo rule
purge_embargo.dependence_limit: A 120h bootstrap block choice does not prove dependence vanishes after 120h; synthetic method acceptance remains mandatory

pair_selection: NONE; full-pipeline synthetic pre-freeze gate only

historical_PIT_classification.causal_feature_rule: At t use completed native rows B[t], B[t-1h], ... only; archive row beginning at t and all reference Opens are forbidden as features at t
historical_PIT_classification.reference_endpoint: Native economic Opens at t+1h and t+5h; no endpoint values computed in this task
historical_PIT_classification.hypothetical_historical_availability: Paired complete economic rows and frozen delayed reference timing; do not fabricate receive timestamps or assume observed on-time eligibility
historical_PIT_classification.revision_claim: Results would describe the pinned current archive snapshot, not original as-received history
historical_PIT_classification.scientific_validity: A precommitted masked one-shot reference-return test can be valid if exposure, source, masking, lock audit, synthetic inference and schedule gates pass; this audit does not establish those gates
historical_PIT_classification.R1_1_change_required: Historical completeness eligibility differs from the R1_1 actual receipt/on-time gate; R1_2 must explicitly freeze the historical estimand and preserve separate forward operational claims

forward_operational_PIT_requirement.R1_1_gate: At least 720 expected paired hourly boundaries; paired on-time point estimate >=99.5% and Wilson 95% lower bound >=99.0%; zero unresolved semantic mismatches, backfilled events or silent revisions; replay hashes exact
forward_operational_PIT_requirement.on_time: max(receive_BTC[t], receive_ETH[t]) < t+1h; late/missing hour remains unavailable and never creates a retroactive event
forward_operational_PIT_requirement.short_forward_confirmation: Distinct operational/source qualification; no duration or outcome pass criterion invented here; freeze independently before observations and deployment

mask_governance_proposal.default_access: DENY; normal feature, label, replay, cache, notebook, CLI and export APIs fail closed
mask_governance_proposal.source_operator: Separate credentials/raw store; no scientific change rights or candidate-result APIs; metadata-only egress
mask_governance_proposal.partition_support_isolation: Warmup, label tail, cooldown state and bootstrap inputs cannot cross masks via development APIs; enumerate support closures before freeze
mask_governance_proposal.unseal_authority: Explicit Controller-signed one-use capabilities; no usable token issued in this audit

H41_SUCCESSOR_HISTORICAL_DISCOVERY_UNSEA.scope: Exactly one frozen Discovery computation/disclosure; no Validation scope

H41_SUCCESSOR_HISTORICAL_VALIDATION_UNSE.scope: Exactly one precommitted Validation evaluation for the locked candidate only

mask_governance_proposal.token_checks: Verify signature/issuer, every binding, state, expiry, recipient and unused nonce at operation time and cold restore; atomically consume capability before outcome access

access_logs.storage: Append-only hash-chained signed log, immutable checkpoints, separate auditor custody
access_logs.masked_log_egress: No event counts, candidate statistics, returns, values or identifying event timestamps in normal-role logs/errors

mask_governance_proposal.lifecycle: Historical development -> masked Discovery -> Candidate Lock -> independent audit -> masked Validation -> short forward confirmation
mask_governance_proposal.incident_policy: Stop and preserve evidence; no favorable-month salvage, runner-up replacement, method switching or redesign on the same compromised sample; Controller chooses new root/fresh authorized data
mask_governance_proposal.legacy_protection: H39, H41 WF1_VALIDATION and existing Final Holdout seals are never implicitly superseded
mask_governance_proposal.public_price_awareness: Not itself contamination; candidate-aligned disclosure to scientific change-rights holders is contamination
